-71.08700,42.36200.name: Moderna
-71.08700,42.36200.desc: Built on messenger RNA delivered in lipid nanoparticles, and now applying the same platform beyond vaccines to cancer, rare disease and protein replacement. The mRNA itself is synthesised chemically rather than grown in an organism, which is why these products are regulated as medicines and never appear in a GMO debate — the instruction is engineered and nothing living is. It is the clearest case on this map of a technology reaching billions of people while sitting outside every framework built for engineered organisms.

3.90000,7.49700.name: International Institute of Tropical Agriculture (IITA)
3.90000,7.49700.state: Ibadan, Nigeria — with research stations across Africa
3.90000,7.49700.desc: A non-profit research institute founded in 1967 by the Ford and Rockefeller foundations, now part of the CGIAR system, headquartered in Ibadan with stations across Africa. Its cowpea breeding programme has released improved varieties in seventy countries, and it maintains the multi-location trial networks against which those varieties are judged. It matters to this facet because the Bt cowpea that Nigeria approved in 2019 — the first engineered food crop cleared for commercial release anywhere in Africa — and its Ghanaian counterpart sit inside that programme's crop and its trial system. Confined field trials of a second-generation construct have run in Nigeria, Ghana and Burkina Faso. The trial plots behind Africa's engineered food crop are held by a philanthropically founded international institute, not by a company and not by a national government.
